title: Rust second, for WebAssembly
description: Stakeholder directive, in the context of Stakeholder directive: Kotlin library first, Rust library second; Stakeholder directive: transpile targets and API-first; WIT, WebAssembly Component Model IDL; jco: JavaScript toolchain for WebAssembly components.

statements.label: Rust second, for WebAssembly
statements.requirement: The second implementation SHALL be a Rust library meeting this same requirement set. It SHALL build for wasm32 as a WebAssembly component implementing the WIT worlds in api/wit, and SHALL be transpiled with jco into an npm package usable from Node.js and browsers. A native crate SHALL also be published. The codec module SHOULD build without std (with alloc).

successCriteria.criterion: The Rust crate builds for wasm32 as a component implementing api/wit, its jco-transpiled npm package loads in Node.js and a browser, and it passes the shared vectors.
